stage: Stage 1 · the skeleton, with every eval
title: The generators
summary: One command now turns acme's blueprint into a working codebase: the API contract, the server, a typed client and a command line, plus a starter handler for each operation that is written once and then left alone. The generated code reuses the blueprint's own declarations, so they can never drift apart. If anyone edits a generated file by hand, the check fails and says which file.
proves: In examples/acme, nx sync writes the four outputs and nx sync:check passes. Editing generated/sdk/... makes nx sync:check fail.

captions.01-generator-tests: The generator's tests: all four outputs, the do-not-edit and scaffold headers, refusals with exit codes, and sync on the real workspace.
captions.02-nx-sync-writes-the-four-outputs: From an empty generated folder: nx sync writes the api, server, sdk and cli, and the model.
captions.03-sync-check-passes: Straight after: the workspace is in sync.
captions.04-generated-acme-typechecks: TypeScript 7 checks acme whole: blueprint, generated code and handler scaffolds.
captions.05-planted-hand-edit-fails-sync-check: Planted: one line added by hand to the generated SDK. sync:check fails and names the file.
captions.06-grant-endpoint-and-scaffold: The generated grant endpoint, and the handler scaffold waiting to be written.
captions.07-generated-cli-refuses-bad-input: The generated CLI refuses a member id without its per_ prefix, exit 2, before any network call.
captions.08-all-checks-green: Lint, typecheck and test across all 14 projects, cache off.
